caseName: Drevaleva v. Appellate Div. of the Superior Court of Cal.
caseNameFull: Tatyana E. DREVALEVA v. APPELLATE DIVISION OF THE SUPERIOR COURT OF CALIFORNIA, SAN MATEO COUNTY

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and the petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeal of California, First Appellate District dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
